description: Focused LLM review repair PRD for PR #46. Scope is restricted to the blocking review findings appended to progress.txt: live Vertex graph share-link expiry/masking wiring and SimpleChart one-bucket pie rendering.

userStories.title: Wire live Vertex graph share-link expiry and masking
userStories.asA: Vertex graph owner sharing a live graph link
userStories.iWant: production share-link reads to enforce expiry boundaries and mask the live JSON-decoded payload shape
userStories.soThat: reviewed security rules protect the actual HTTP share-link surface, not only the pure helper package

acceptanceCriteria.given: a live graph share link whose ExpiresAt equals the request time
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is HTTP 410 Gone and the graph payload is not returned

acceptanceCriteria.given: a live graph share link for a graph payload decoded from JSON with node objects under nodes
acceptanceCriteria.when: an outside viewer fetches the graph through the share-link endpoint
acceptanceCriteria.then: node property values are masked while graph name, node ids, and other structural fields remain visible

acceptanceCriteria.given: the live share-link store is PostgreSQL-backed
acceptanceCriteria.when: share links are created and loaded
acceptanceCriteria.then: ExpiresAt is persisted and scanned without breaking existing revoked-link behavior

verification: Targeted graphsvc handler BDD tests for expired live links and JSON-decoded node masking.

userStories.title: Render one-bucket pie charts as a full circle
userStories.iWant: pie charts with exactly one positive bucket to render a visible full circle
userStories.soThat: single-result aggregations do not appear blank when data exists

acceptanceCriteria.given: a SimpleChart pie chart with exactly one positive bucket
acceptanceCriteria.then: the SVG contains a visible full-circle mark for that bucket

acceptanceCriteria.given: a SimpleChart pie chart with multiple positive buckets
acceptanceCriteria.then: existing slice path rendering is preserved

verification: Targeted Vitest regression for one-bucket pie charts.
